svg.title: Gregory's Awesome Teams — context engineering for the IBM Bob harness
svg.desc: An animated diagram in three acts. First a Bob context window fills with the system prompt, rules, MCP tools, messages, file reads and tool results until it passes the 190k compaction threshold. Then compaction fires and the older turns collapse into a single conversation summary, losing the middle of the conversation. Finally the kit's features appear: AGENTS.md, four always-on rules, nine skills, references and examples, the Firecrawl MCP server, the slash command, TASKS.md and four setup scripts, together with the build chain discover, grill, spec, implement, evals, demo.
svg.text: Prompt, context and harness engineering for the IBM Bob harness

g.text: Every turn re-sends all of it, so cost grows
System prompt, rules and skills survive it.
The decision you made at turn 3 may simply

svg.text: stop existing, and nothing tells you.

g.text: Anything written to a file survives.

svg.text: Anything left in the scrollback does not.

g.text: Loaded every single turn, so it is kept short on purpose
evidence over memory / context / finish the work / tests
Only the description sits in context; the body loads on demand
Depth Bob reads when a skill cites it, not every turn
Search returns page content, so ten calls become one
One command routes discovery through to demo day
State in a file survives compaction; scrollback does not
macOS Intel, Apple silicon, Linux, Windows 11
